text:
Priya S.: quick heads-up — ran a lightweight link+anchor scan against /kb this morning. found 3 dead anchors and one staging image returning 403. can someone pick these up? i can coordinate small PRs across the day.

Jamie: can you paste the list and the minimal repro? happy to take one.

Priya S.: sure — results below (wg: ripgrep + a small HTML check):
```
/kb/runbook/production.md#deploy-steps -> anchor not found
/kb/onboarding/curl-examples.md#auth-headers -> anchor not found
/kb/kv-cache.md#cache-warmup -> anchor not found
/assets/onboarding/screenshot-2.png -> 403 in staging env
```

Priya S.: ripgrep command i used: `rg "\#(cache-warmup|auth-headers|deploy-steps)" content/ -n` — quickly catches missing anchors if headings were renamed.

Sam K.: i'll claim kv-cache.md and open a tiny sed PR to restore the heading/id (should be 2 lines). tagging @priya for context.

Jamie: i'll take the runbook and the curl-examples. leaning to normalizing headings rather than adding manual anchors.

docs-bot: auto-scan created meta-issue #2142 for dead anchors (link: https://go/repo/issues/2142).

Leo: for the screenshot 403 — looks like staging bucket policy rotated last night. @eng-infra FYI, i'll file infra-ticket if we can't rehost quickly.

Priya S.: thanks all. plan: Sam & Jamie open PRs, i will review and coordinate merges. if reviewers are clear, target merge by 14:00 UTC. please ping thread with PR links (and add `docs:fix-anchor` label). :thumbsup:

Jamie: posting PR soon — will request review from @priya and @leo.

Sam K.: PR posted: https://go/repo/pulls/2345 — changed heading id + small note. @priya PTAL.

Priya S.: reviewing now. small nit but LGTM, will approve in PR.

Leo: filed infra ticket for staging asset 403: https://go/repo/issues/2143 — assigned to eng-infra. if infra can't rehost within the day, we can reupload to `/assets/rehost-temp/` and update link in onboarding.

Priya S.: perfect. keeping this thread for async check-ins. thanks everyone for the quick pickup.
